inputs.text: An Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent sprang into action after a baby stopped breathing while the child and family were stuck in a crowded TSA line at JFK International Airport in New York on Thursday. Video released by the Department of Homeland Security showed a man holding the baby notice that something was wrong.

output.main_topic: An Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent responding to a baby who stopped breathing in a crowded TSA line at JFK International Airport
subtopics: Baby and family stuck in an airport security line
